title: Book Two · Chapter 2: Under the Book
story:
On Tuesday, Miss Wu puts a red card on each pair of desks.

There is a thin sheet of paper beside every card.

"A short note game today," Miss Wu says.

Leo reaches for his at once.

“Wait,” she says. “Read first.”

Ronan looks at the note.

Put the red card under the book.

Put the pencil beside the card.

He knows all the words. He picks up the card and lays it on top of his book. Then he puts the pencil beside it.

“Done,” he whispers.

Leo is still reading. His finger moves along the first line.

Miss Wu walks between the desks. She stops by a girl near the door, then comes to them.

“Read the first line to me, Ronan.”

He reads it.

“Now show me under.”

Ronan looks down. The red card is on top. He moves it quickly.

“Was it there a moment ago?”

“No.”

“Then leave it on top for now. We will look at it.”

His face grows hot. Leo looks at the card but says nothing.

Miss Wu takes a cup and a small cloth to the front table.

She puts the cloth on the cup. Then she puts it under the cup.

“These are different places.”

She asks two children to come closer. One reads a new note. The other moves the cloth. The first try is right. On the second, both children reach for the cup and nearly knock it over.

Miss Wu catches it.

“One reader. One pair of hands,” she says.

Leo puts his own hands behind his back.

“I am the reader.”

Ronan turns the note towards him.

Leo reads the first line. Ronan puts the card under the book. The edge of the card still shows.

“The pencil beside the card,” Leo reads.

“There is a book over it now.”

“Beside the edge, then.”

They look at the note again. Miss Wu comes back.

“Does it tell you to hide the whole card?”

“No.”

“Then you can leave an edge out.”

Ronan moves his hand away. This time he checks both objects. Then he tells Miss Wu he is ready.

At break, Jun asks for a red card. He wants to fold it into a tiny box.

“They belong to the classroom,” Ronan says.

“I know. I am asking Miss Wu.”

Ronan gives him the card. Jun carries it to her desk and comes back with a smaller piece instead.

“Mine can be a smaller box.”

Leo tries to put a rubber inside it. The sides fall open.

“It is a very open box,” he says.

Jun takes the rubber out and folds the corners again.

After lunch, Ronan opens his reading book. A loose page drops onto his knees. He puts it back, then takes out the morning note.

He draws two little books in the empty space. On one, he puts a red square. Under the other, he draws only a red edge.

Leo looks at them.

“Your book has a tongue.”

Ronan makes the red edge longer.

“A very long tongue.”

He leaves that picture beside the first line. Tomorrow he and Leo will change jobs.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

under＝在下面；on top＝在上面；edge＝边缘；towards＝朝向。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan第一次把卡片放错在哪里？
2. 两人第二次怎样分工？

## 读句子

Leo / reads the first line.＝Leo／读第一行。
